cards.title: The new loop
cards.text: Your answers put together as one loop. Mark any part I got wrong, and comment where I guessed.
cards.why: This replaces permanent levels. Everything in camp is built on it, so it's worth getting right before stage 3.
cards.pick: Build it as written in stage 3.

parts.title: Levels live in a run
parts.text: Every run starts at level 1. Kills give XP and levels during the run. Leaving or losing resets them.

parts.title: Gold is forever
parts.text: You keep all gold whether you win, lose or leave. It's spent at camp.

parts.title: Skill trees
parts.text: One per hero, four branches: attack, survival, support, movement. Bought with gold, kept forever. Nodes are abilities, stat buys you can take again, or trinket slots.

parts.title: Feats
parts.text: Some nodes need a feat first, like "reached level 8 in a run", or a level reached during the run before they work.

parts.title: Party slots
parts.text: You start with one hero. More slots cost gold, each dearer than the last. Heroes at home get nothing.

parts.title: Mercenaries
parts.text: Instead, hire a weak-to-middling party for one run. You don't keep them, and they take half the gold.

parts.title: Recovery
parts.text: A hero downed in a run rests for a while in real time. Gold cuts it short. Meanwhile you go in with someone else.

parts.title: Gems
parts.text: A second, rare currency that unlocks new heroes. Bosses drop them; my guess, since you didn't say where they come from.

parts.title: Leaving
parts.text: Leave between rooms any time and keep the trinkets found. If the party is wiped, those trinkets are lost, as before.

parts.title: Choosing a dungeon
parts.text: Camp offers a few dungeons, each a different theme and difficulty. No recommended level shown.
